nearbyHelp: Receivers that answered on this network.
emptyPeers: No receivers yet. On the other computer, open this app. Copy the address shown under Receive into Send.
sendHelp: Choose a file. Paste the address from his Receive screen. Press Send. Both of you compare the code, then he presses Accept.
shareHelp: Share does not use his address. It makes a link and a QR.
receiveHelp: Nothing is written until you accept.
historyHelp: Names and results only. File contents are not kept here.
demo: Send a sample file to this computer
danger: This file type can run code. Accept only if you asked for it.
webHelp: One link, one download. The QR is the address.
qrHelp: Scan this with a phone on the same Wi-Fi. It opens a page you can save.
openHelp: Each QR opens one photo, video, or file. The first code opens the course description.
addPdf: Add a photo, video, or PDF
auto: Auto-accept verified contacts under the limit
step1Title: Send a file to someone nearby.
step1Body: It stays on this network. Nothing is uploaded to an account.
step2Title: Compare the code before you accept.
step2Body: If the numbers differ, decline. The program will not decide for you.
step3Title: What should other people call this computer?
